description: Where a draft or a listing is: collecting, awaiting_owner, declined, processing, ready or needs_attention. Pass draftId (it reports the listing once started) or listingId. waitSeconds (up to 25) holds the answer until something changes. A video usually takes a few minutes.

waitSeconds.description: Seconds (0 to 25) to hold the answer until the status changes; 0 answers at once.

name: get_listing_status
title: Check a listing's progress
